title: Muriate
summary: MU'RIATE, noun [Latin muria, muries, salt water, brine; amarus, bitter; Heb. to be bitter.] A salt formed by muriatic acid combined with a base.

inlines.v: MU'RIATE, noun [Latin muria, muries, salt water, brine; amarus, bitter; Heb. to be bitter.] A salt formed by muriatic acid combined with a base.
